title: AS2: Array methods compilation (push/pop/splice/sort)
description: Verify Array method calls compile correctly. arr.push(x), arr.pop(), arr.splice(i,n), arr.sort(), arr.join(), arr.reverse(), arr.concat() should all compile as ActionCallMethod. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/arraymethods.test.ts: each method call compiles without error and bytecode contains ActionCallMethod (0x52).
